newsitem.title: USA: Dynatronics to post gain from land sale.
newsitem.headline: Dynatronics to post gain from land sale.

text.p: Dynatronics Corp said on Monday that it expects to report a gain of $0.02 a share from the sale of two acres of undeveloped land adjacent to its Salt lake County facility to Candlewood Hotels.
The property's sale price was $1 million, Dynatronics said.
A portion of the proceeds will be used to effect a tax-free exchange for a 22,500 square foot building near Chattanooga, Tenn., which the company currently leases, Dynatronics said.

Dynatronics said it expects to save over $50,000 annually by eliminating lease payments. Also in the exchange, it will get two adjacent acres of land for its expanding line of medical supplies and soft goods, Dynatronics said.
